g.text: HARNESS WIRE LIST (EVERY WIRE NUMBERED) AND CONNECTORS
Ambient · AON-1 (Ambient Orbital Node 1) 3U CubeSat · rev A
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR X.X ±0.1 [±.004] · X.XX ±0.05 [±.002] · HOLES +0.1/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · THREADS ISO 965 6H · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: RBF + umbilical port (front-face Gecko 4-way RBF socket J106
burn rail + element switches to E05
burn + element switches from E01 J7
RF in to the phasing network
1. 67 wires; 11.8 m of ETFE wire plus 0.15 m coax. Cut lengths include 60-110 mm service loop and routing; trim at the harness board.
2. Crimp Gecko-SL contacts with the Harwin hand tool listed for G125 contacts on the Harwin datasheet, pull-test 1 per 10 crimps (IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 3 space addendum).
3. Twist the pairs: SA± (2 + 2), MTQ±, SUN/SUN_RTN, NTC/NTC_RTN, UART TX/RX with GND. Lace with waxed polyester cord, tie-down every 50 mm to the frame lacing points with 2216 dots.
4. Mark each wire end with its W-number on a heat-shrink label (Raychem TMS-SCE, low outgassing).
5. Route panel harnesses along the frame corner blocks clear of the rods; keep MTQ wires ≥ 20 mm from the magnetometer on E03 (the RM3100 sits at the E03 centre).
6. Continuity + 500 V DC insulation (> 100 MΩ) of each harness before installation (AON-900 T9).
